requirementAudit.completionRule: Every G06 original requirement needs evidence at its own scope. Synthetic/browser/model/static results do not qualify physical UIKit or human IME. G13 responsibilities remain explicit.

method: GUI-owned atlases rasterize complete Unicode extended graphemes, shared by drawing and caret measurement.
Private negative tint marker preserves color glyph RGB with unchanged vertex layout; legacy alpha masks retain theme tint.
Both fragment and vertex stages receive output color-space specialization.
Native B fixture explicitly distinguishes one ZWJ emoji from two independent consecutive emoji.
limits: Initial grapheme fix used a finite configured repertoire; the subsequent dynamicInputGlyphs fix extends input display/preedit/placeholder text. Full shaping and arbitrary system-font fallback remain outside scope.
CDP IME remains synthetic; real human IME and full physical lifecycle checklist are separate.

dynamicInputGlyphs.diagnosis: Device logs store A😀我 / A😀啊 without broken UTF-16. The configured atlas omitted these glyphs, causing ? fallback.
dynamicInputGlyphs.method: Input display/preedit/placeholder clusters extend per-family atlases; generations are reused until new glyphs are needed, and GPU submission lifetime retires replacements.
dynamicInputGlyphs.lengthPolicy: Existing UTF-16 maxLength remains unchanged; truncation respects complete grapheme boundaries.
dynamicInputGlyphs.capacity: Automatic growth is bounded by min(4096, device.maxTextureDimension2D); exhausted atlas uses existing missing-glyph fallback without continuous rebuild.

behavior.password: Eye toggles GPU plaintext without changing secure native host/clipboard policy; preserves selection; remasks on blur.
behavior.lengthCounter: Committed UTF-16 length / maxLength; reserves text gutters.
